analysis.projected_radius_definition: 1-sigma covariance ellipse computed from PLY rotation and exp(log-scale), projected with the embedded pinhole camera Jacobian
analysis.detail_metric: mean absolute first-order grayscale gradient per 32x32 tile
analysis.density_metric: projected Gaussian center count per 32x32 tile

interpretation_rules.density_supported: far-depth tiles have materially lower center density and detail retention increases with center density
interpretation_rules.footprint_or_bandwidth_supported: far-depth tiles do not have materially lower density, while projected radii are larger and/or rendered high-frequency retention decreases with depth
interpretation_rules.boundary: This is a center-view representation diagnostic, not a novel-view quality result and not a causal sample-count ablation.
